author: /root/consequence_next_hypothesis
research_question: At the matched C1 4096-update endpoint, does one complete-rollout std adaptation change single-trajectory planning, and what safety/progress tradeoff accompanies it?
conditional_recommendation: One new formal candidate only if actual registered SMOKE4 and PROFILE240 and independent correctness/systems reviews pass, then Lead binds a separate exact RUN_APPROVAL. This artifact supplies scientific design, not those approvals.

control.label: L
control.reuse: Completed historical C1; independently justified only under matched Base/data/order/seed/recipe/evaluation. Never relabel source or resume as a normalized run.

candidate.label: N
candidate.start_from: Common original S0 learned FP32 masters; fresh optimizer, never C1 endpoint or diagnostic weights.

normalizer.raw_advantage: Original FP32 per-scene G4 reward minus FP32 scene mean
normalizer.population: All complete valid G4 candidates across all ranks at one old-policy optimizer boundary, including zero groups; before microbatch slicing

matched_training.TRAIN_order_and_sampler: Original unchanged manifest order and tools.ddpolicy_vehicle.training_state.epoch_batches, seed42
matched_training.frozen: Original Qwen; original trainable action-head/DiT/projection range and GT/input contract unchanged
matched_training.on_policy_membership: Each arm refreshes its own old policy and feedback; historical control ledger is not new-arm training data.

evaluation.official_reference: Unchanged official single-candidate reference, common campaign_id; exact input/reference identity verified across both arms.
evaluation.primary_estimand: 100 * scene-weighted mean_i(PDMS_N_i - PDMS_L_i), in percentage points
evaluation.log_resampling: Draw16 paired logs with replacement per replicate, retain all scenes within every drawn log, compute scene-weighted mean; report by-log and equal-log sensitivity.

metric_units.scores: fraction in artifacts; delta displayed as percentage points

evaluation.missing_policy: Keep requested population and report failures; no valid zero deletion, no missing fill or complete-case promotion. Primary full-population result INCOMPLETE until all paired records valid.
evaluation.empty_strata: null estimate and interval, explicit zero denominator and undefined bootstrap counts
evaluation.model_selection: Only fixed4096 endpoint; no best epoch/seed/trajectory, extra early evaluation, or outcome-dependent extension.

bidirectional_safety_and_progress.zero_score: All four zero/nonzero transition cells, full and conditional denominators, net repair; zero means score <=1e-8
bidirectional_safety_and_progress.NC_DAC_TTC: Separate canonical value transitions; improved iff N-L>1e-8, worsened iff L-N>1e-8, otherwise tied. Report scene/log counts and retain NC 0/0.5/1 semantics; no safety-only denominator replacing full population.
bidirectional_safety_and_progress.high_score: Original control-defined >=0.9 group: any drop >1e-8, large drop >0.05, high-to-zero; original zero/middle/high strata retained.
bidirectional_safety_and_progress.EP: Original EP drop >0.05 and safety_gain_with_ep_drop; opposite exchange is EP_N-EP_L>0.05 AND any canonical NC/DAC/TTC decrease >1e-8. No new threshold search.
bidirectional_safety_and_progress.interpretation: PDMS gain with worse canonical safety is a tradeoff, not a safety improvement. Null or rare-event evidence does not establish equivalence/noninferiority. No numeric quality PASS margin introduced.

TRAIN_risk_evidence.source: Sealed evidence decision; no full reanalysis
TRAIN_risk_evidence.interpretation: Cross-update reweighting risk, not a paired gradient/safety effect. Same-batch relative gaps do not preserve absolute full-training error costs.
TRAIN_risk_evidence.single_batch_gradient_limit: Not a multiplier selection or global gradient conclusion.

existing_training_telemetry.strata_limit: Each arm uses treatment-dependent on-policy strata; not fixed paired causal subgroups. Count actual safety scenes/logs separately from all batch members.
existing_training_telemetry.clip_limit: old/current ratio~1 before sole reuse1 update; clip0.2 does not bound post-optimizer change.

stopping_and_nonexpansion.identity_data_numeric_resource_failure: Follow original stop contract, retain last complete native state; no automatic modified-config retry.

future_admission_required: Actual registered SMOKE4 and PROFILE240 complete receipts, independent correctness and efficiency/resource interpretation bound to exact source/config.
Lead final FORMAL registration, updated method identities, same common initialization/data/order/seed/recipe, fresh resource lease and RUN_APPROVAL.
At exact4096, immutable native/checkpoint/export/score and original DEV/metric/reference identities, independent evaluation compatibility checks and authorized endpoint analysis.
